name: halo-search
title: Halo Search
description: A rounded search field with a magnifier on the right, wrapped in layered blurred gradients. The halo shifts on hover and glows harder while the field has focus.
use: A dark hero or command area wants a search field that feels alive without extra UI.
avoid: The field width is fixed near 300px, and the glow is very dim on light backgrounds.
a11y: The input is focusable but labelled only by its placeholder, and the magnifier tile is a span that cannot be clicked. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide, rounded dark input sits on near-black, with pale Search... text on the left and a rounded magnifier tile on the right. A soft pink and violet glow leaks out around its border.
behaves: The glow drifts slowly at rest, swivels when the pointer enters, and flares to a brighter pink ring once the field is focused. Typing fills the bar while the halo keeps shifting.
customise: Only className is exposed; the placeholder, field size, colours and glow layers are written into the component's style block.
weight: light: Several blurred gradient layers with CSS transitions; no script.
